svg.aria-label: The submit skill. Boxes: Sheet agent: the submission sheet from your folder and the public instructions (agent); Nothing from the folder in the sheet: the run ends with what was found (stop); You approve the sheet, correct it or answer its questions (stop); The extension not connected: the run ends with the sheet (stop); A field the sheet lacks, added to it as a question (stop); A sign-in, a licence, a copyright transfer, a consent or a payment that blocks a page (stop); A page that does not pass: the portal's message, with its row (stop); The page of the final submit: you press it (stop); A run folder that exists: a run folder of the same date stands (stop); Which config, for a folder that holds several funder configs (stop).
